1	/**
2	 * Load-time validation and routed-model policy resolution for compaction-basic.
3	 *
4	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic/config
5	 */
6	
7	import type { LlmCallConfig } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
8	import { deepFreeze } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-values'
9	import type {
10	  BasicCompactionConfig,
11	  CompactionPolicyConfig,
12	  ModelCompactPolicyConfig,
13	  ResolvedCompactSpec,
14	  ResolvedConfig,
15	  ResolvedRetention,
16	  ResolvedTargetPolicy,
17	} from './types.ts'
18	
19	/** Default request-pressure fraction for every routed model. */
20	const DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_RATIO = 0.8
21	
22	/** Default verbatim-tail fraction for every routed model. */
23	const DEFAULT_RETAIN_RATIO = 0.16
24	
25	/** Fields shared by top-level defaults and exact-target overrides. */
26	const POLICY_CONFIG_KEYS = [
27	  'thresholdRatio',
28	  'retainRatio',
29	  'retainTokens',
30	  'summarizationProvider',
31	  'summarizationModel',
32	  'maxTokens',
33	  'compactionRetries',
34	  'maxOverflowRetries',
35	] as const
36	
37	/** Complete public top-level configuration key set. */
38	const BASIC_COMPACT_CONFIG_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
39	  ...POLICY_CONFIG_KEYS,
40	  'modelPolicies',
41	  'auto',
42	])
43	
44	/** Complete exact-target override key set. */
45	const MODEL_POLICY_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
46	  'provider',
47	  'model',
48	  ...POLICY_CONFIG_KEYS,
49	])
50	
51	/** Target-specific pressure configuration failure eligible for warning suppression. */
52	export class TargetPressureConfigError extends Error {
53	  /**
54	   * @param targetKey - exact provider/model route used as the warning key.
55	   * @param message - actionable configuration failure detail.
56	   */
57	  constructor(readonly targetKey: string, message: string) {
58	    super(message)
59	  }
60	}
61	
62	/**
63	 * Resolve and validate service defaults plus exact-target partial overrides.
64	 * @param config - untrusted plugin configuration after Loader normalization.
65	 * @returns detached immutable defaults and validated exact-target overrides.
66	 */
67	export function resolveConfig(config: BasicCompactionConfig = {}): ResolvedConfig {
68	  validateKeys(config, BASIC_COMPACT_CONFIG_KEYS, 'BasicCompactionConfig')
69	  validatePolicy(config, 'BasicCompactionConfig')
70	  if (config.auto !== undefined && typeof config.auto !== 'boolean') {
71	    throw new Error('BasicCompactionConfig: auto must be a boolean')
72	  }
73	
74	  const thresholdRatio = config.thresholdRatio ?? DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_RATIO
75	  const retention = resolveRetention(config, { retainRatio: DEFAULT_RETAIN_RATIO })
76	  validateRatioRetention(thresholdRatio, retention, 'BasicCompactionConfig')
77	  const modelPolicies = resolveModelPolicies(config.modelPolicies)
78	  for (const [index, policy] of modelPolicies.entries()) {
79	    validateRatioRetention(
80	      policy.thresholdRatio ?? thresholdRatio,
81	      resolveRetention(policy, retention),
82	      `BasicCompactionConfig: modelPolicies[${index}]`,
83	    )
84	  }
85	
86	  return deepFreeze({
87	    thresholdRatio,
88	    ...retention,
89	    summarizationProvider: config.summarizationProvider ?? '',
90	    summarizationModel: config.summarizationModel ?? '',
91	    maxTokens: config.maxTokens ?? 8192,
92	    compactionRetries: config.compactionRetries ?? 1,
93	    maxOverflowRetries: config.maxOverflowRetries ?? 1,
94	    modelPolicies,
95	    auto: config.auto ?? true,
96	  })
97	}
98	
99	/**
100	 * Merge the exact provider/model override over the validated default policy.
101	 * @param config - validated service defaults and override table.
102	 * @param target - exact durable provider/model route to match.
103	 * @returns detached immutable policy before model-capacity scaling.
104	 */
105	export function resolveTargetPolicy(
106	  config: ResolvedConfig,
107	  target: Pick<LlmCallConfig, 'provider' | 'model'>,
108	): ResolvedTargetPolicy {
109	  const override = config.modelPolicies.find(policy => (
110	    policy.provider === target.provider && policy.model === target.model
111	  ))
112	  const inheritedRetention: ResolvedRetention = config.retainTokens === undefined
113	    ? { retainRatio: config.retainRatio }
114	    : { retainTokens: config.retainTokens }
115	  return deepFreeze({
116	    target: { provider: target.provider, model: target.model },
117	    thresholdRatio: override?.thresholdRatio ?? config.thresholdRatio,
118	    ...resolveRetention(override ?? {}, inheritedRetention),
119	    summarizationProvider: override?.summarizationProvider ?? config.summarizationProvider,
120	    summarizationModel: override?.summarizationModel ?? config.summarizationModel,
121	    maxTokens: override?.maxTokens ?? config.maxTokens,
122	    compactionRetries: override?.compactionRetries ?? config.compactionRetries,
123	    maxOverflowRetries: override?.maxOverflowRetries ?? config.maxOverflowRetries,
124	  })
125	}
126	
127	/**
128	 * Scale one routed policy into concrete token budgets for its model capacity.
129	 * @param policy - merged policy for the exact routed target.
130	 * @param contextWindow - positive adapter-owned capacity for that target.
131	 * @returns detached immutable pressure and retention budgets.
132	 */
133	export function resolveCompactSpec(
134	  policy: ResolvedTargetPolicy,
135	  contextWindow: number,
136	): ResolvedCompactSpec {
137	  const targetKey = `${policy.target.provider}/${policy.target.model}`
138	  if (!Number.isInteger(contextWindow) || contextWindow <= 0) {
139	    throw new TargetPressureConfigError(
140	      targetKey,
141	      `BasicCompactionConfig: contextWindow (${contextWindow}) must be a positive integer`,
142	    )
143	  }
144	  const thresholdTokens = Math.floor(contextWindow * policy.thresholdRatio)
145	  const retainTokens = policy.retainTokens === undefined
146	    ? Math.floor(contextWindow * policy.retainRatio)
147	    : policy.retainTokens
148	  if (retainTokens >= thresholdTokens) {
149	    throw new TargetPressureConfigError(
150	      targetKey,
151	      `BasicCompactionConfig: ${policy.target.provider}/${policy.target.model} retainTokens `
152	      + `(${retainTokens}) must be less than threshold tokens ${thresholdTokens}`,
153	    )
154	  }
155	  return deepFreeze({
156	    target: { ...policy.target },
157	    contextWindow,
158	    thresholdRatio: policy.thresholdRatio,
159	    thresholdTokens,
160	    retainTokens,
161	    summarizationProvider: policy.summarizationProvider,
162	    summarizationModel: policy.summarizationModel,
163	    maxTokens: policy.maxTokens,
164	    compactionRetries: policy.compactionRetries,
165	    maxOverflowRetries: policy.maxOverflowRetries,
166	  })
167	}
168	
169	/** Choose an explicit retention form or inherit the already-resolved fallback. */
170	function resolveRetention(
171	  config: CompactionPolicyConfig,
172	  fallback: ResolvedRetention,
173	): ResolvedRetention {
174	  if (config.retainTokens !== undefined) return { retainTokens: config.retainTokens }
175	  if (config.retainRatio !== undefined) return { retainRatio: config.retainRatio }
176	  return fallback
177	}
178	
179	/** Reject a capacity-independent retention conflict at plugin load. */
180	function validateRatioRetention(
181	  thresholdRatio: number,
182	  retention: ResolvedRetention,
183	  name: string,
184	): void {
185	  if (retention.retainRatio !== undefined && retention.retainRatio >= thresholdRatio) {
186	    throw new Error(
187	      `${name}: retainRatio (${retention.retainRatio}) must be less than `
188	      + `the resolved thresholdRatio (${thresholdRatio})`,
189	    )
190	  }
191	}
192	
193	/** Validate, detach, and reject duplicate exact-target policies. */
194	function resolveModelPolicies(configured: unknown): ModelCompactPolicyConfig[] {
195	  if (configured === undefined) return []
196	  if (!Array.isArray(configured)) {
197	    throw new Error('BasicCompactionConfig: modelPolicies must be an array')
198	  }
199	  const seen = new Set<string>()
200	  return configured.map((source: unknown, index) => {
201	    const name = `BasicCompactionConfig: modelPolicies[${index}]`
202	    assertModelPolicy(source, name)
203	    const key = `${source.provider}\u0000${source.model}`
204	    if (seen.has(key)) {
205	      throw new Error(
206	        `BasicCompactionConfig: duplicate model policy for ${source.provider}/${source.model}`,
207	      )
208	    }
209	    seen.add(key)
210	    return { ...source }
211	  })
212	}
213	
214	/** Validate one untrusted exact-target override and narrow its public type. */
215	function assertModelPolicy(
216	  source: unknown,
217	  name: string,
218	): asserts source is ModelCompactPolicyConfig {
219	  if (!isUnknownRecord(source)) throw new Error(`${name} must be an object`)
220	  validateKeys(source, MODEL_POLICY_KEYS, name)
221	  assertNonEmptyString(`${name}.provider`, source.provider)
222	  assertNonEmptyString(`${name}.model`, source.model)
223	  validatePolicy(source, name)
224	}
225	
226	/** Validate the fields common to defaults and exact-target partial overrides. */
227	function validatePolicy(
228	  config: CompactionPolicyConfig | Record<string, unknown>,
229	  name: string,
230	): void {
231	  const thresholdRatio = config.thresholdRatio
232	  const retainRatio = config.retainRatio
233	  const retainTokens = config.retainTokens
234	  const maxTokens = config.maxTokens
235	  const compactionRetries = config.compactionRetries
236	  const maxOverflowRetries = config.maxOverflowRetries
237	  if (thresholdRatio !== undefined) assertRatio(`${name}.thresholdRatio`, thresholdRatio)
238	  if (retainRatio !== undefined) assertRatio(`${name}.retainRatio`, retainRatio)
239	  if (retainTokens !== undefined) assertNonNegativeInteger(`${name}.retainTokens`, retainTokens)
240	  if (retainRatio !== undefined && retainTokens !== undefined) {
241	    throw new Error(`${name}: retainRatio and retainTokens are mutually exclusive`)
242	  }
243	  if (maxTokens !== undefined) assertPositiveInteger(`${name}.maxTokens`, maxTokens)
244	  if (compactionRetries !== undefined) {
245	    assertNonNegativeInteger(`${name}.compactionRetries`, compactionRetries)
246	  }
247	  if (maxOverflowRetries !== undefined) {
248	    assertNonNegativeInteger(`${name}.maxOverflowRetries`, maxOverflowRetries)
249	  }
250	
251	  validateSummarizationPair(config, name)
252	}
253	
254	/** Require one scope to omit, clear, or replace the summarization target as a pair. */
255	function validateSummarizationPair(
256	  config: CompactionPolicyConfig | Record<string, unknown>,
257	  name: string,
258	): void {
259	  const provider = config.summarizationProvider
260	  const model = config.summarizationModel
261	  if (provider !== undefined && typeof provider !== 'string') {
262	    throw new Error(`${name}.summarizationProvider must be a string`)
263	  }
264	  if (model !== undefined && typeof model !== 'string') {
265	    throw new Error(`${name}.summarizationModel must be a string`)
266	  }
267	  if (provider === undefined && model === undefined) return
268	  if (provider === undefined || model === undefined
269	    || (provider.length === 0) !== (model.length === 0)) {
270	    throw new Error(
271	      `${name}: summarizationProvider and summarizationModel must be set together `
272	      + 'as an empty or non-empty pair',
273	    )
274	  }
275	}
276	
277	/** Reject stale or misspelled keys before defaults can hide them. */
278	function validateKeys(config: object, keys: ReadonlySet<string>, name: string): void {
279	  for (const key of Object.keys(config)) {
280	    if (!keys.has(key)) throw new Error(`${name}: unknown key "${key}"`)
281	  }
282	}
283	
284	function isUnknownRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
285	  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
286	}
287	
288	function assertNonEmptyString(name: string, value: unknown): asserts value is string {
289	  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length === 0) {
290	    throw new Error(`${name} must be a non-empty string`)
291	  }
292	}
293	
294	function assertPositiveInteger(name: string, value: unknown): asserts value is number {
295	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) {
296	    throw new Error(`${name} (${String(value)}) must be a positive integer`)
297	  }
298	}
299	
300	function assertNonNegativeInteger(name: string, value: unknown): asserts value is number {
301	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0) {
302	    throw new Error(`${name} (${String(value)}) must be a non-negative integer`)
303	  }
304	}
305	
306	function assertRatio(name: string, value: unknown): asserts value is number {
307	  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0 || value > 1) {
308	    throw new Error(`${name} (${String(value)}) must be a number in (0, 1]`)
309	  }
310	}

1	/**
2	 * Surface retention selection and the shared log-recorded compaction
3	 * transaction for automatic open-turn and manual idle-session compaction.
4	 *
5	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic/region
6	 */
7	
8	import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
9	import { isDeepStrictEqual } from 'node:util'
10	import {
11	  CompactionId,
12	  ManualCompactionError,
13	  compactCheckpointSource,
14	  toolPairingBalancedAfter,
15	  toolPairingBalancedBefore,
16	} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction'
17	import type { CompactionResult } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction'
18	import type { CommandId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands/brand'
19	import { createUserMessage, errorChain } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
20	import type { Message, UserMessage } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
21	import type { TokenMeasurement, TokenMeter } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter'
22	import type { Session, SessionEvent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
23	import type { Agent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'
24	import { frameSummary } from './summarizer.ts'
25	import type { SummarizationInput, SummaryResult } from './summarizer.ts'
26	
27	interface RegionDependencies {
28	  readonly meter: TokenMeter
29	  summarize(input: SummarizationInput, agent: Agent, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<SummaryResult>
30	}
31	
32	/** One validated inclusive span of current surface positions. */
33	interface SurfaceSelection {
34	  readonly start: number
35	  readonly end: number
36	  readonly startIdx: number
37	  readonly endIdx: number
38	  readonly shadowedSeqs: readonly number[]
39	}
40	
41	/** A selection with its priced snapshot and the replay input built from it. */
42	interface PreparedCompaction extends SurfaceSelection {
43	  readonly measurement: TokenMeasurement
44	  readonly selectedNodes: TokenMeasurement['nodes']
45	  readonly shadowedTokenCount: number
46	  /** Route-priced total of the selected span; the shrink comparison's unit. */
47	  readonly shadowedRouteTokenCount: number
48	  readonly input: SummarizationInput
49	}
50	
51	type SummarizedCompaction = PreparedCompaction & SummaryResult & {
52	  readonly checkpointMessage: UserMessage
53	}
54	
55	interface CompactionTransactionOptions {
56	  /** `current-turn` derives a numbered owner; `null` writes a standalone bracket. */
57	  readonly owner: 'current-turn' | null
58	  /** Surface relationship that must survive asynchronous summarization. */
59	  readonly stability: 'whole-surface' | 'selected-span'
60	  /** Optional durability checkpoint after a successfully closed bracket. */
